t: Fortron is a form of energy that MFFS machines use as a source of power. It is produced and stored initially by the $(l:mffs:machines/coercion_deriver)Coercion Deriver$() to then be transferred to other machines by the $(l:mffs:machines/fortron_capacitor)Fortron Capacitor$().
Fortron是一种MFFS机器所使用的能量形式，最初由$(l:mffs:machines/coercion_deriver)Fortron 衍生器$()产生并储存，再通过$(l:mffs:machines/fortron_capacitor)Fortron 能量储存器$()传输给其他机器。

Another source of Fortron energy is a creative-only item known as the $(5)Infinite Power Card$(). It can be placed directly into a $(l:mffs:machines/fortron_capacitor)Fortron Capacitor$() (left most item slot) to provide an infinite supply of Fortron. Fortron is able to exist as a liquid. It may be pumped directly from a Capacitor and manipulated in the same way Water or Lava can.
Fortron能量的另一来源是一种仅限创造模式使用的物品——$(5)无限能量卡$()。它可直接插入$(l:mffs:machines/fortron_capacitor)Fortron 能量储存器$()（最左侧物品栏）中，从而提供无限的Fortron供应。Fortron可以液态形式存在，能够像抽取水或岩浆一样，直接从电容器中泵出并进行操控。
